_comment: Grouping rules for DYNAMICALLY created views in the unified viewer's
Teams / Views rail. A view is any metadata.team value that has no
config/teams/<id>.json registry entry — it appears because some agent
session wrote observations under that team name.
Each rule folds every matching view into one collapsible subgroup so the
list stays readable as new views appear. Rules are applied in order; the
first match wins. A view matching no rule renders as its own row.
`match` is a JavaScript regular expression source string, anchored by the
author (not implicitly), tested case-insensitively against the team id.

groups.label: Kgbench
groups.description: Benchmark run trees — one team per kgbench sandbox worktree (lib/kgbench/sandbox.mjs mints kgbench-tree-<id> per run).
